title: Keep lunch moving
pedagogy: No new vocabulary. One lunch encounter: check availability, order water, check spice, request non-spicy food, understand the price. Sentence practice uses earlier food and response frames, not isolated word recognition. Spoken tones and particle distinctions are inherited from the existing vocab entries. Distractors change the requested item, intent, or stage of the encounter.

exercises.title: One lunch, several turns
body: You are a woman ordering lunch. Check what is available, ask about the food, and respond when the vendor gives a price.
Keep the same scene in mind as you move between listening, filling a gap, building a sentence, and choosing a reply.

exercises.gloss: have + water + question particle + female question particle
exercises.explanation: มี + น้ำ + ไหม + คะ checks availability with words from earlier units.

exercises.thai: ขอน้ำหน่อยค่ะ

choices.thai: ขอน้ำหน่อยค่ะ
choices.meaning: Could I get some water, please? (female speaker)

choices.thai: มีน้ำไหมคะ

exercises.explanation: ขอ makes a request; มี…ไหม checks availability. They move the conversation forward in different ways.

exercises.meaning: Could I get some water, please? (female speaker)
exercises.explanation: Keep the request frame and put the drink in its object slot.

exercises.gloss: this-one + spicy + question particle + polite(f, question)
exercises.explanation: Point to the dish with อันนี้, then ask เผ็ดไหมคะ.

exercises.context: At lunch, the vendor offers you water. You are a woman and would like some.

speaker.thai: เอาน้ำไหมคะ

exercises.question: What do you say next?

choices.thai: ขอน้ำหน่อยค่ะ
choices.note: Requesting the offered water accepts the offer and says what you want.
This declines the water, but you want some.
This says it is delicious; you have not received it yet.

exercises.thai: ไม่เผ็ดครับ

choices.thai: ไม่เผ็ดครับ
ขอข้าวครับ

exercises.explanation: ไม่ changes the spice request. Listen to the whole phrase, not just its polite ending.

exercises.meaning: Could I get some water, please? (female speaker)
exercises.gloss: ask-for + water + softener + female polite particle
exercises.explanation: Build the same request from sound this time.

exercises.meaning: How much is this one? (female speaker)
exercises.gloss: thing + this + how-much + female question particle
exercises.explanation: Replace the spice question with a price question while keeping อันนี้.

exercises.context: You have asked the price of your lunch. The vendor says 35 baht. You want to thank her.

speaker.thai: สามสิบห้าบาท

exercises.question: What do you say next?

choices.note: ขอบคุณ thanks the vendor after she answers.

choices.thai: อันนี้เผ็ดไหมคะ
choices.note: That returns to asking about spice; you want to thank her now.
That declines the order rather than thanking her.
